sources.snippet: AMD MI300X vs NVIDIA H100 at a Glance The short version: MI300X wins on memory capacity and per-GPU-hour price at some providers; H100 wins on realized compute throughput, networking, and low-batch latency. Neither GPU is a strict upgrade over the other, the right pick depends on your model size and batch profile.
